prompt: Why does the notice direct some swimmers to the warm pool?
promptZh: 為什麼通知請部分泳客改去溫水池？

options.text: It opens before the lift test starts.
options.zh: 它在升降椅開始測試前就開放。
options.whyZh: 測試八點半開始，溫水池九點才開。

options.text: It has a separate entrance and changing rooms.
options.zh: 它有另外的入口和更衣室。
options.whyZh: 兩池都使用平時相同的入口和更衣室。

options.text: Its entry ramp does not depend on the lift being ready.
options.zh: 它的下水坡道不受升降椅是否就緒影響。
options.whyZh: 使用者可走不受測試影響的坡道，不必等主池升降椅。

options.text: Anyone with a morning ticket can already use both pools.
options.zh: 持晨間票的人原本就可以使用兩個池。
options.whyZh: 晨間票通常限指定泳池，特定情況才可轉票。

explanationZh: 使用者可走不受測試影響的坡道，不必等主池升降椅。
evidence: The main pool opens at 7 a.m. on Wednesday. The warm pool opens at 9 a.m. Both use the usual entrance and changing rooms. | Staff will test the main-pool lift at 8:30. Before they confirm the test is complete, swimmers who need help entering the water should ask reception to reserve a place in the warm pool. Its ramp is independent of the lift test. Do not enter the main pool by lift until a staff member confirms it is available.

vocabulary.note: 可分開運作，不需要先完成另一件事。
